comment: The module has no inputs at all, so nothing in the patch can clock, reset or transpose it. The panel prints Gate under the envelope output while the maker's own port name calls it Envelope CV A (0-10V); the code produces an attack-sustain-decay ramp, not a gate. Rnd rewrites all sixteen slots of the sequence even when Length is shorter. The hold length is the Rise time plus one pass of the sequence, varied by up to a tenth either way.
